findings: [12] The source prints «Кевис» (Kevis) here and «Кебес» (Kebes) at [14] for the same person, Cebes; both rendered “Cebes.”
[14] «Симлий» (Simliy), printed throughout ([14], [16], [18], [20], [21], [22], [30]), is evidently Simmias (Russian «Симмий»); rendered “Simmias.”
[20] «взаимодеиствие» is a slip for «взаимодействие» (vzaimodeystvie, 'interaction'); translated as 'interaction.'
disposition: Retain the audited Russian source and SHA-256 unchanged. None of these readings affects meaning, so the unit is not held out of reviewed status; Confirm against the printed volume 41 at the next print-witness pass.
